registry_correction: GN: ITS under the 2021 CGI (L/2021/032/AN), not 'RTS'; access B.
headline: Guinea built from the 2021 CGI (in force 2022; LF 2025 has no tax article; LF 2022-2024 not read): final monthly ITS 0-20 % (also on pensions) with no family relief, IRCM 15 % final; a final monthly withholding makes uneven pay cost up to 3,5 times more.

w5_pattern_a.added: CNSS employee 5 % of the monthly wage up to the 2 500 000 GNF plafond, deducted from the ITS base (art. 58)
w5_pattern_a.provision: CNSS page "Cotisations sociales employeurs" (cnss.gov.gn, fetched 2026-11-20): plafond 2 500 000, plancher 550 000, 23 % = employeur 18 % + salarié 5 %; official secondary (the rate / plafond décrets under the Code 1994 arts. 32-33 not reached)
